threads.body: When this data source is configured only through `serverName`/`portNumber`/`databaseName` connection properties, `getURL()` is null. `JdbcConnectionUrlParser.parse()` returns `DEFAULT` immediately for a null URL (`instrumentation/jdbc/library/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/jdbc/internal/JdbcConnectionUrlParser.java:117-120`) without applying those properties, so these pools still receive the shared `oracle-ucp` fallback. Handle an absent URL with `JdbcConnectionPoolNameUtil.poolName(connectionProperties, DEFAULT_POOL_NAME)` and cover that configuration in the test.

[Style] `VirtualField` instances are constant-like semantic handles under the Java style rules, so this `static final` field must use `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`. Rename it to `METRIC_POOL_NAME_FIELD` and update its references.

[Style] The style guide says not to add `final` to classes under `javaagent/src/main/`.

```

[General] Connection properties feed the derived name when a JDBC URL is present too — `shouldDerivePoolNameFromConnectionProperties` sets `jdbc:oracle:oci8:@` and still derives `properties.example:1523/inventory` from them. Only the values read directly off `PoolDataSource` are limited to the no-URL case.

properties and the JDBC URL, when present. Without a JDBC URL, it also uses the standard
`serverName`, `portNumber`, and `databaseName` values exposed directly by the `PoolDataSource`.

```

The host is optional here: `JdbcConnectionPoolNameUtil.poolName` emits only the database or service name when no server address is known. That happens for a TNS-alias URL such as `jdbc:oracle:thin:@orcl`, and when only `databaseName` is configured.

```suggestion
not have an explicitly configured connection pool name. The derived format is
`host[:port][/database-or-service]`, or just `database-or-service` when no host is known. When the
connection information is unavailable, the fallback name is `oracle-ucp`. Pools connected to the
same database intentionally share the derived name, so
```

[General] `putAll` copies only this `Properties` object's direct entries and drops values inherited through its defaults chain. `JdbcConnectionPoolNameUtil` intentionally resolves defaults via `getProperty` (and tests that behavior), so a no-URL data source configured with default `serverName`, `portNumber`, or `databaseName` values will derive an incomplete/fallback name here. Preserve the source as the defaults while overlaying its direct entries.
